answer: Proposal: cap glacier-data rewards at 100 active survey rights, not keys. A jetty contract transfers a right only after retiring its old payout slot; validators reject a mirror claim and forfeit pending rewards if its owner signs two transfers. A farm can share one model and rent rights, but each clone needs a different active right: each lender loses its prior payout. No loan reuses a right concurrently; 100 clones cannot create a 101st stream. Without a retired parent slot the child earns zero. This closed initial roster is a proposed permissioned trade-off, not MinePoA policy.
